hero.title: Periscopic Relay Imaging
hero.description: In use at IQC's NPQO Lab for diamond nitrogen-vacancy (NV) center qubit measurements. A vertical-scanning microscope with a downward-facing objective and optical access through a cryostat window.

currentWork.title: Built for the experiment.
paragraphs: PRISM V5 is used in the Nano Photonics and Quantum Optics Lab at the Institute for Quantum Computing, University of Waterloo. Current work involves diamond NV-center qubit measurements inside a cryostat.
The objective sits above the sample enclosure and looks down through its window. My work has included mechanical design, fabrication coordination, optical integration, and scanning control.

configuration.title: A downward-facing objective. A window into the experiment.
configuration.description: PRISM is an objective-scanning microscope. Its vertical configuration places the objective above the cryostat, giving the optics access to the enclosed diamond sample through a window.

work.text: Mechanical design, custom fixtures, CNC-ready drawings, and assembly across successive instrument builds.

homeLab.title: From the optical bench to the home lab.
paragraphs: My home lab is where I explore motion, measurement, and practical optical tooling. Current projects include an encoder-equipped stage and a tool for inspecting stage precision.
These are independent builds alongside my lab work. I share the experiments, adjustments, and development process on KicoLabCO.

collaboration.title: A conversation could start the next experiment.
collaboration.description: I'm looking for external funding opportunities and research conversations that could support further work on PRISM and precision tooling. If your lab has a related problem, I'd be glad to talk.

items.title: 2024–2025 · Instrument development
items.text: PRISM grew through successive builds during my IQC Research Assistant and Associate Researcher appointments, from early concepts and custom tooling to V5 laboratory integration.

items.title: Early commercialization exploration
items.text: I explored forming a company around the project and prepared provisional patent documentation and technical drawings. Nothing was filed, and those company plans are paused.

items.title: Current direction
items.text: PRISM V5 supports diamond NV-center qubit measurements at IQC. My independent home-lab work continues through optical and precision-tooling experiments.
